title.th: ประกาศโรคติดต่อ (พื้นที่ติดเชื้อ) 2004

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Infectious Diseases (Infected Areas) Notification 2004 and shall come into operation on 14th June 2004.
2. The Minister hereby declares the areas set out in the second column of the Schedule to be infected areas in respect of the diseases set out in the third column thereof.
3. Gazette Notification No. 3306 published on 5th October 1998 is cancelled.
